subject.title: Páginas de autor publican texto de Wikipedia (CC BY-SA) e imágenes de Commons sin atribución

question: Should author pages avoid CC BY-SA/Commons obligations by regenerating descriptions from CC0 facts and filtering images to PD/CC0, or should Hamelyn keep Wikipedia/Commons content and add full attribution/license metadata?
rationale: Both paths are plausible and affect legal exposure, SEO content, image availability, stored data shape, and public UI; automation should not choose that policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Avoid CC obligations
options.body: Generate descriptions only from CC0 Wikidata facts, stop storing Wikipedia extracts, and only cache images whose Commons metadata is PD/CC0, using the fallback image otherwise.

options.title: Keep content with attribution
options.body: Persist source, author, license, license URL, and file/article links, then show attribution on the author page and include appropriate structured-data/source context.

options.title: Containment first
options.body: Temporarily suppress stored author descriptions/images from the public author page while the final ingestion and data-cleanup path is decided.

recommendation.title: Avoid CC obligations
recommendation.body: Generate descriptions only from CC0 Wikidata facts, stop storing Wikipedia extracts, and only cache images whose Commons metadata is PD/CC0, using the fallback image otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the current enrichment lines by blame and already performed the issue triage that identified the containment path.
